## PnetCDF output (`outputs: type: pnetcdf`) {#sec-ch14-pnetcdf}

status: draft

### Summary

The PnetCDF writer takes the same output options as NetCDF (@sec-ch14-netcdf), with two restrictions. It writes
NC_FLOAT only, and it requires `blocks_per_process: 1`.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What**: all ranks write one shared file per frame collectively, through the `pinc` wrapper of PnetCDF; there is
no combine step. **Switch**: YAML `outputs: - type: pnetcdf`; CMake `PNETCDF`. **Default**: CMake `PNETCDF=ON` on
Linux, OFF on macOS. **Requires**: the Python package `pinc` at configure time; one block per process. **Order**:
exact copy rounded to float. **Defining equation**: none.
:::

### Derivation

None.

### Numerical method

`PNetcdfOutput`'s constructor rejects `double_precision: true`, so a misconfigured run fails at setup and not at its
first output (`PNetcdfOutput`, {{< code src/output/pnetcdf.cpp PNetcdfOutput::PNetcdfOutput >}}). `write_output_file` skips the final write,
repeats the precision check, and throws if the process holds more than one block
({{< code src/output/pnetcdf.cpp PNetcdfOutput::write_output_file >}}). Each block then posts its own slab of each variable with
a non-blocking `ncmpix_iput_vara_float` and waits for it.

With `PNETCDF=ON`, CMake runs the configured Python to import `pinc` and takes its include directory and library;
configuring fails if `pinc` cannot be imported ([`parameters.cmake:28-43`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/cmake/parameters.cmake#L28-L43)). A
build without it rejects `type: pnetcdf` when the block reads its outputs: "Output type 'pnetcdf' requires
PNETCDF=ON" (`PNETCDFOUTPUT`, {{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::reset >}}).

### Tests

No ctest exercises PnetCDF output at the pin. According to the text of PR #213, the refusal of `double_precision` was checked
by hand on one rank when it was added; that is not a registered test.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
- Multi-rank PnetCDF output is covered by no test.
- No double precision; use `type: netcdf` for it.
- One block per process only.
:::
